cs.t: +1 for Baratza. I have an old Virtuoso grinder that's about 10 years old and still going strong, never had an issue.

I've been using a Baratza Virtuoso grinder for 2 years now.  I'm really happy with it, and it probably suffices for everything up to super fine espresso grinds.  ~$200 on amazon  [1] -- $230 right now but watch it for a couple days [2].  Just one warning: if you live in an apartment, it produces a fairly loud low grumbling sound.  I think it's fine, but if you have super thin walls up get up at the crack of dawn it's something to consider. [1]  http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B006MLQHRG  [2]  http://camelcamelcamel.com/Baratza-Virtuoso-Conical-Coffee-G...
